reason: B is the stronger proposal because the thermally stable Ce–Zr overlayer, controlled by ALD, provides a more credible single intervention for oxygen transfer and suppression of sintering, and it tests both low-temperature performance and high-temperature aging against an uncoated baseline. Both lack the requested supporting citations and may risk oxide-induced site blocking, but A’s exclusively sub-150 °C aging conditions do not adequately represent vehicle-lifetime thermal degradation.
